evidence: Get a commit: 'If there are more than 300 files in the commit diff... the response will include pagination link headers for the remaining files, up to a limit of 3000 files.' Compare: 'without any paging parameter (per_page or page), the returned list is limited to 250 commits'.
correction: Optionally add: file pagination is capped at 3000 files.

evidence: Between 1-100 MB: '...when using the object media type, the content field will be an empty string and the encoding field will be "none".' Files over 100 MB unsupported.
correction: Phrase as 'files between 1 MB and 100 MB' (doc says 1 MB or smaller is fully supported; >100 MB not supported).

evidence: 'For queries that exceed the time limit, the API returns the matches that were already found prior to the timeout, and the response has the incomplete_results property set to true.' No HTTP status code is stated.
correction: Search timeouts return the matches found before the timeout with incomplete_results=true. Drop 'HTTP 200' or mark it [verify] (not stated in the doc).

evidence: Post dated 2025-08-08: brownout 2025-09-08, implementation 2025-10-07; 'The author_association field will be removed from multiple event types'. Nothing about status codes or in-place change; rollout 'behind a feature flag'.
correction: GitHub announced removal of payload fields (author_association from 7 event types, push commit summaries/counts, some PR fields) from the Events API effective 2025-10-07, without a new API version. Drop 'still returning 200'.

evidence: 'The maximum and default for the limit parameter has been reduced to 15 objects.' Rate 'limited to 1 request per minute, unless they are approved for the Slack Marketplace'; applies to apps created after May 29, 2025 and net new installations.
correction: Note it covers conversations.history and conversations.replies, for commercially distributed non-Marketplace apps; internal customer-built apps and existing installs exempt.

evidence: 'Apps without the intent will receive empty values in fields that contain user-inputted content with a few exceptions' (own messages, DMs, mentions, context-menu target).
correction: Mention exceptions; MESSAGE_CONTENT is a privileged intent requiring approval.

evidence: Commit df01db34 by Rapptz, 2023-05-03, 'Initial support for pomelo migration'; adds `if self.discriminator == '0':` handling. whats_new v2.3.0: 'Update __str__ for User to drop discriminators if the user has been migrated.'
correction: Quote is in docs/whats_new.rst (v2.3.0), not the commit diff. 'No schema change' is only true of the discriminator field: pomelo also added a new global_name field.

evidence: 2022-06-27 Get Users: 'Deprecated the view_count field... The response continues to include the field; however, it contains stale data.' 2023-02-28: tag_ids '...it will only return an empty array.'
correction: tag_ids returns an empty array (Search Channels, Get Streams, Get Followed Streams); dates 2022-06-27 and 2023-02-28.
